latency.provenance: Per-invocation cost with a *persistent* runtime session, measured by the npu-runtime workstream (/home/asdf/projects/npunlock-work/npu-runtime/README.md, build/npu-runtime-bench --runs 200); kernel-lib's own probe (tools/klib_probe, fresh process, one graph create per call) measures 26-76 ms per run, which is the graph-recreate class, not kernel time.
latency.note: The numbers are per invocation of the whole patched graph, not per element: a 32-element tile costs the same as a 1-element tile, which is why larger carriers (graph compiler) are the lever, not kernel tuning.

measured_toolchain_rules.rule: fp32 ADD/SUB with two *runtime* register operands is computed correctly only with the '; fmt=2' register-form asm hint
measured_toolchain_rules.evidence: add_f16_packed is byte-exact on the NPU with the hint and returns in[i] + <hardware constant> without it (reports/npu-evidence.json case add32_lib vs the unfixed build)

measured_toolchain_rules.rule: fp32 ADD/MUL whose operand is a hardware-selector literal (0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 1.41494, 0.70604, pi, e, 10.0) is computed correctly only WITHOUT the hint (the compiler chooses the constant-selector encoding deliberately)
measured_toolchain_rules.evidence: silu_f16 (1.0f + expf(-x)) is bit-exact with FIXUP=off and wrong with FIXUP=on; x + 1.0f returns x+1 unfixed and x fixed

measured_toolchain_rules.rule: fp32 MUL of two runtime registers does not compute the product in either mode (returns one of the operands): x*x returns x, in[i]*in[i^16] returns the partner
measured_toolchain_rules.evidence: throwaway probes k_rrmul.c / k_mulrr.c, both fixup modes

measured_toolchain_rules.rule: mlibm CALLs work: expf and tanhf are bit-exact/1-ULP on the NPU
measured_toolchain_rules.evidence: silu_f16 executes bit-exact (mismatched_elements = 0) and the tanhf/expf probes return the correctly rounded values

measured_toolchain_rules.rule: the v1 porting-probe contract (npunlock-linux-probe and tmpdump dump_probe) only accepts 32-byte tensors, i.e. a 1x16 fp16 carrier
measured_toolchain_rules.evidence: src/linux_probe/main.c:248; tools/klib_probe.c exists to run any size
